Metadata.title: StudyFlow AI
Metadata.description: An AI-powered learning workspace for notes and flashcards.

Hero.subtitle: AI-powered learning workspace
Hero.description: Bring your study materials together and turn them into clearer notes and useful flashcards as StudyFlow grows.
Hero.materialsDescription: Keep each subject in one space.

Features.title: A clearer way to study
Features.description: StudyFlow is being built around a simple flow: organize a subject, understand its material, and review what matters.
Features.spacesDescription: Give every subject its own place for materials and future study tools.
Features.notesDescription: Turn dense reading into structured summaries you can revisit.
Features.flashcardsDescription: Practice key ideas with short question-and-answer cards.

Pricing.title: Start with the essentials
Pricing.description: StudyFlow is in development. Plans and pricing will be announced before paid features become available.
Pricing.previewDescription: Create an account and explore your learning workspace while we build the first study tools. Payments are not available yet.

FAQ.title: Questions, answered
FAQ.oneAnswer: StudyFlow AI is a learning workspace being built to help students organize materials and create notes and flashcards.
FAQ.twoQuestion: Can I upload a PDF now?
FAQ.twoAnswer: Yes. Upload a text-based PDF in a study space to generate structured study notes. Scanned PDFs are not supported yet.
FAQ.threeAnswer: Pricing has not been announced. This preview does not collect payments.
